title: Licenses.
bodyText: No person shall act as an insurance producer in connection with mass merchandising of insurance, unless the person is licensed as such under article 9A.
bodyHtml: §431:12-114  Licenses.  No person shall act as an insurance producer in connection with mass merchandising of insurance, unless the person is licensed as such under article 9A. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 2002, c 155, §79]
